posts.text:
It's been 15 years since I quit my corporate job...

That was easily one of the best decisions of my lifetime. Zero of you would have heard of me if I stayed on that path and my life would be more boring.

And they probably would have tried to get me to put pronouns in my bio.
posts.summary: Corporate pressure to adopt progressive identity practices like pronouns
